statement.zh: 文献将 72 号丘表述为卡霍基亚著名的密西西比葬仪土墩之一（Fowler 1997；Pauketat 2004）；细节待专刊加厚。
statement.en: Literature frames Mound 72 as one of Cahokia's famous Mississippian mortuary mounds (Fowler 1997; Pauketat 2004); details deferred to specialist reports.
